groups.rationale: Reviewed incoming scanner and harness repairs: Docker source context includes declared release inputs, Nix builders join nixbld without disabling sandboxing, and experimental Compose paths now match /opt/overalls exports. Controlled pools retain zero native credit and reject retired standby keys under existing ADR-0177; no deployed role or recorded hosted/native acceptance changes.

Merged the lifecycle chapter describing vm.failed after a newly durable journal outcome, without changing per-tick failure cleanup. Native provenance and all-false capability claims and the focused distributed-fixture review remain intact; the controlled actor property does not establish physical recovery.

Reviewed the merged lifecycle chapter against native protocol admission and the expanded guest/agent/security mapping. Journal-bound failure-event deduplication changes no protocol, native provenance, boot-ID or all-false admission contract; existing native machine gaps remain explicit.

Reviewed merged actor/executor/driver logging and the generated failure/recovery/restart/new-command property: vm.failed now follows a newly recorded durable outcome, while idempotent physical failure cleanup still re-drives. The hermetic test-helper environment cleanup changes no deployed privilege boundary; native boot/provenance refusal and absent machine acceptance remain documented.

Reviewed Lyra update-lock contract and tests: production mark_failed remains nonblocking and preserves a concurrent lock holder outcome. The new duplicate-descriptor regression and test quiescence clarify existing behavior; native service supervision, all-false admission and linked-image/machine gaps remain unchanged.

Reviewed added antithesis context check exports and aligned Compose/runtime paths. They build existing experimental harness contexts without changing host placement, native image construction, unavailable-kernel refusal or recorded execution evidence; the operations chapter already requires complete fresh Compose startup and keeps hosted/native gaps explicit.

Reviewed the expanded native architecture review for target type checks, pinned fs2 provenance and supervisor ordering. The mapped reference, coverage and security chapters already state all-false admission, kernel-file identity limits and absent native machine evidence; these review details add no further handbook behavior.
